description: Metadata for public Information Commissioner's Office pages about artificial intelligence on ico.org.uk. Each canonical URL was confirmed with one bounded GET. The catalog stores the title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page bodies are not stored. A missing date is unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. creative_commons means CC0, CC BY, or CC BY-SA without a restricted deed. uk_ogl means the page states the Open Government Licence. Crown copyright alone is not a licence. runner_wired is false.
